questions.question: Is barium considered a toxic metal?
questions.answer: According to [[sources/ufelle2021-metals-chapter|Ufelle & Barchowsky 2021]], barium is listed among the minor toxic metals for which toxicity has been described. Beyond noting that toxicity has been described, this page does not detail specific barium health effects.

questions.question: Does this page have detailed information about barium in food or consumer products?
questions.answer: No. This page is currently a source-map stub and provides source-map context only. The cited toxicology chapter does not include a detailed barium subsection, so specific dietary, exposure, or product information is not yet covered here.

questions.question: What source does the information about barium come from?
questions.answer: The barium entry draws on [[sources/ufelle2021-metals-chapter|Ufelle & Barchowsky 2021]], the "Toxic Effects of Metals" chapter (Ch 23) in Casarett & Doull's Essentials of Toxicology, 4th ed. It is referenced here for its listing of barium among minor toxic metals rather than for a dedicated barium analysis.
